title: Polk County School Board, District 3 (runoff)
what_it_does: School board members set the district budget and school millage, hire and evaluate the superintendent, approve curriculum materials, and set district policy.
verified_ballot_note: Runoff per LkldNow (https://www.lkldnow.com/school-board-elections-district-3-heads-to-run-off-fields-and-sharpless-cruise-to-victory/) and The Ledger/Yahoo. Nonpartisan.

candidates.name: Kate Wallace
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Appointed by Gov. Ron DeSantis in November 2025 to fill the vacancy created by the death of board member Rick Nolte.
candidates.primary_result: Led Aug 18 primary with 45.1% (39,265); forced to runoff
